text: 创业板指跌超2%，早盘一度涨近2%，贵金属、游戏、机器人、短剧等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4600只
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 2%, having risen nearly 2% in early trading; precious metals, gaming, robotics and short drama led the declines, with more than 4,600 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
